rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses that six samples cannot support a correlation network and substitutes a named prior network (STRING v12.0, combined_score >= 700) with sample-level module scoring, an honest permutation floor of 0.2, and a well-specified ORA (expressed-gene universe, 15-500 window, versions recorded). It loses on method fit because it still builds a WGCNA network on the six samples and reports eigengene-condition correlations, which the reference explicitly marks as wrong regardless of the 'diagnostic' label. It never runs the gene-level DESeq2/edgeR contrast the reference projects the prior network onto: the design formula and reference level are stated but no contrast is tested, no alpha is named, and no fold-change shrinkage is applied, so the model and FDR/shrinkage criteria are only partly met. QC and reporting are otherwise thorough, with reproducibility and limitations sections stated.
